data.name: Take The Wheel
data.detailed_description:
Take the Wheel is a quiet, dreamlike platformer about the things we carry throughout life, and that despite that we keep going. You are a teddy bear moving through a surreal world. The path ahead is yours, but something is always behind you.

You move through a surreal landscape, collecting scattered music notes and pieces of a broken clarinet. Instruments of calm, now fragmented. A shadow car trails behind you; never urgent, always present. The world is soft and strange, somewhere between sleep and memory. The narrator speaks as you move, working through questions they haven't answered yet: what it means to forgive yourself. To stay in control and keep going anyway. The teddy bear keeps moving. So do you.

• Dreamlike platforming across a surreal landscape (a world that feels somewhere between sleep and memory)

• Collect scattered music notes and clarinet fragments (piece together something broken as you move through the dream)

• A looming shadow car (always behind you, never urgent. atmosphere, not obstacle)

• A narrator working through real things (quiet reflections on control, fear, and what keeps us going)

• 1–2 hours (a complete emotional experience, not a grind)


After a car accident that left them shaken but unhurt, the narrator finds themselves in a recurring dream. A teddy bear moves through an endless world, collecting the pieces of something whole. The clarinet is an instrument they once played, once found calming, but is now scattered across the world in fragments. Reassembling it means moving forward. The shadow that follows is not a monster. It is doubt.

data.short_description: Some days you just keep moving. Play as a teddy bear collecting scattered clarinet pieces while a shadow car follows close behind. A quiet narrative platformer about control, forgiveness, and finding your way back.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 960 / RX 480 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
